facts.projectSummary:
## MPG Site Records — App Plan

**Company:** My Project Group Ltd
**Concept:** A native iOS/iPad app that replaces messy WhatsApp invoices, PDFs and photos with one standard company system for construction subcontractors. Tradesmen log allocated work, take photos, upload receipts, complete daily site records and submit weekly invoices/timesheets. Admin (Steve) and site managers review, approve, query and pay.

**Platform scope note:** 10x builds native iOS (iPhone + iPad), not web/Android/desktop browser. Delivered as a native iOS app covering the same functionality.

### v1 Status — COMPLETE (mock/local-first)
Role-based entry with mock auth (Admin / Site Manager / Tradesman). All three role experiences built and navigable end to end. Site Files Hub, geofenced clock-in/out, and Attendance overview shipped.

---

## NEXT FEATURE — Offline Work Logging (scoping)

**Why:** Tradesmen on site often have no reliable connectivity (basements, rural sites, steel-frame buildings, poor signal). Right now every log action assumes data is saved instantly to the in-memory store. On a real backend that means lost daily records, photos, materials, and clock-ins when signal drops. The app must let a tradesman capture everything offline and sync it automatically once back online, with clear status so nothing is silently lost.

### What must work offline
- **Daily site records** — write/edit fully offline.
- **Materials / receipts** — add offline with captured photo.
- **Site photos & file uploads** — captured and queued; binary stored locally until upload.
- **Geofenced clock-in / clock-out

metadata.appStoreDescription:
MPG Site Records replaces messy WhatsApp threads, loose photos and one-off PDFs with one standard company system for construction subcontractors and the office that pays them.

Built for tradesmen working on real sites, the app keeps the whole week in order. See the work you have been allocated, complete daily site records, capture before, during and after photos, log materials and receipts, clock in and out with GPS geofencing, and submit your weekly timesheet and invoice when the job is done.

For the office, admins and site managers get a single dashboard to review submissions, chase missing receipts, query hours, approve work and pay on time.

FOR TRADESMEN

Today's Work shows every allocated job with address, hours, trade and what is required on site.

Job Details keeps the brief, times, site manager and notes from the office together, with quick actions to take a photo, add materials or submit a daily record.

Daily Site Records capture start time, finish time, breaks, work carried out and any delays, with the day's total hours calculated for you. Dictate your record hands-free and let the app fill in the details for you to review.

Photos are timestamped and linked to the job automatically, sorted as before, during or after works.

Materials and receipts are filed against the right job so nothing goes missing before invoicing.

Weekly invoices show net due, hours and CIS deductions, with clear draft and paid status and the Monday submission deadline in view.

Your profile holds trade and business details plus compliance information such as UTR, NI number, CIS status and VAT.

FOR ADMINS AND SITE MANAGERS

The Office Dashboard shows invoices to review, active tradesmen, active sites and total outstanding at a glance.

Clear alerts flag materials purchases missing a receipt and invoices submitted after the deadline, so problems are caught before payment.

Sites and the tradesmen working them stay organised in one place, ready to review, query, approve and pay.

WHY TEAMS USE IT

One standard system for every job, instead of scattered messages and files.

Honest daily records and GPS clock-ins that hold up when it matters.

Photos and receipts filed by job, ready at invoice time.

Faster review and payment for the office.

MPG Site Records is built for My Project Group Ltd and the subcontractors who work with them.

reviewNotes: MPG Site Records is a closed, invite-only business tool used by My Project Group Limited and its authorised subcontractors. New accounts cannot be self-registered; they are provisioned by an admin.
A demo account has been prepared for App Review. Please use the credentials provided in the demo account checklist below.

The app requests location permission (when in use only) to confirm the user is on or near an allocated site at the moment of clock-in, clock-out, or evidence upload. Location is never accessed in the background.
The microphone and speech recognition permissions are used together for on-device dictation of daily site records. No audio is stored or transmitted.
The camera permission is used to photograph site progress and capture receipts. Photos are timestamped and attached to the relevant job record.
Photo library read permission allows attaching existing photos and documents to jobs. Photo library write permission saves captured site photos back to the library.
OpenAI API integration is used to assist with intelligent feature processing within the app. No personally identifying data beyond what is necessary for the feature is transmitted.

The app contains user-generated content (site records, photos, receipts) visible only to the submitting tradesman and authorised admins and site managers within the same organisation. There is no public-facing content feed.

intro: This Privacy Policy explains how My Project Group Limited ('we', 'us', or 'our') collects, uses, and protects information when you use the MPG Site Records iOS application ('App'). By using the App you agree to the practices described here. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.

bullets: Account information: your email address and a user identifier created when you register through Supabase Auth.
Profile information: your trade, business name, UTR number, National Insurance number, CIS status, and VAT details as entered by you.
Daily site records: start and finish times, break durations, work descriptions, delays, and any notes you enter or dictate.
Photos and images: timestamped site photos (before, during, and after works), receipt images, and supplier invoice scans you capture or select from your library.
Materials and receipts: item descriptions, costs, and linked images you log against a job.
Timesheet and invoice data: hours worked, net amounts due, and CIS deduction information.

Location data: a single location reading captured at the moment you clock in or out, or upload site evidence, to confirm proximity to the allocated site. Location is not tracked continuously or in the background.
Voice input: audio spoken into the daily site record dictation feature. Audio is transcribed on-device using Apple's speech recognition and is not stored or transmitted as a recording.
Usage and diagnostic data: anonymised interaction events and crash reports collected via integrated analytics.
paragraphs: We collect information you provide directly, information generated as you use the App, and information from your device with your permission.
sections.title: Information We Collect

bullets: To provide and operate the App, including authenticating your account, displaying allocated work, and enabling site records, clock-ins, and invoice submissions.
To enable admins and site managers to review, query, approve, and pay submissions.
To confirm your location at the moment of a clock-in, clock-out, or evidence upload.
To auto-fill your daily site record using on-device speech transcription.
To improve reliability and fix errors using aggregated, anonymised analytics and crash reports.
To communicate with you about your account or your use of the App.
paragraphs: We use the information we collect for the following purposes:
sections.title: How We Use Information

bullets: Camera: used to photograph work progress and capture receipts on site. Photos are timestamped and attached to the relevant job.
Microphone: used only during active dictation of a daily site record. Audio is processed on-device and is not stored.
Speech Recognition: used to transcribe spoken site records into text for your review. Transcription runs on-device via Apple's framework.
Photo Library (read): allows you to attach existing photos, receipts, and supplier invoices from your library to a job or daily record.
Photo Library (write): allows the App to save site photos you capture to your photo library.
Location (when in use): a single location reading is taken when you clock in or out, or upload site evidence. The App never accesses location in the background.
paragraphs: The App requests the following device permissions. You may manage these at any time in iOS Settings.
sections.title: Device Permissions And Sensitive Data

bullets: Supabase: our backend infrastructure provider stores account data, site records, photos, and other App data on our behalf. Data is processed subject to Supabase's data processing terms.

OpenAI: we use OpenAI's API to support certain intelligent features within the App. Only the content necessary for the feature is transmitted; we do not send identifying information where it can be avoided.
Analytics provider: anonymised usage and diagnostic events are sent to our analytics service to help us improve the App. This data is not linked to your identity for advertising purposes.
Authorised personnel: admins and site managers within My Project Group Limited may view records, photos, and invoices you submit as part of normal business operations.
Legal requirements: we may disclose information if required to do so by law or in response to a valid legal process.
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information. We do not share your information for third-party advertising or cross-app tracking.
sections.title: How We Share Information

paragraphs: We retain your account information and submitted records for as long as your account is active and for a reasonable period thereafter to meet our business and legal obligations. You may request deletion of your account and associated personal data at any time by contacting us at the address below. We will process deletion requests within a reasonable timeframe, subject to any legal retention requirements.
sections.title: Data Retention

bullets: You can review and update your profile information from within the App.
You can withdraw device permissions (camera, microphone, location, photo library) at any time in iOS Settings. Withdrawing some permissions will limit certain App features.
You can request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
You can request deletion of your account and personal data by contacting us at info@my-project.co.uk.
paragraphs: You have choices regarding your information:
sections.title: Your Choices

paragraphs: MPG Site Records is a professional tool intended for use by adults engaged in construction subcontracting. The App is not directed at children under the age of 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided personal information to us, please contact us immediately and we will take steps to delete that information.
sections.title: Children's Privacy

paragraphs: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your data rights, please contact My Project Group Limited at:
Email: info@my-project.co.uk
We will endeavour to respond to all enquiries within a reasonable timeframe.

intro: Need help with MPG Site Records? Our support team is here to assist tradesmen, site managers, and admins with any questions or issues. Please read the sections below before getting in touch — many common questions can be resolved quickly with the right information.

bullets: Email: info@my-project.co.uk
Email is preferred for account and data queries as it allows us to respond with a written record. We aim to respond to email enquiries within two business days.
paragraphs: You can contact the MPG Site Records support team by email or phone:
sections.title: How To Reach Support

bullets: Your full name and the email address registered to your account.
Your role in the App: tradesman, site manager, or admin.
A clear description of the problem, including what you were trying to do and what happened instead.
The iOS version on your device and the version of MPG Site Records you are using (found in Settings within the App).
Screenshots or screen recordings if the issue involves something visual.
The approximate date and time the issue occurred.
paragraphs: To help us resolve your issue as quickly as possible, please include the following details when you contact us:
sections.title: What To Include In Your Request

paragraphs: If you are unable to sign in, have forgotten your credentials, or believe your account has been set up incorrectly, please contact support with your registered email address. For security reasons we may ask you to verify your identity before making changes to your account.

If you need your account to be deleted and your personal data removed, email us at info@my-project.co.uk with the subject line 'Account Deletion Request'. We will process your request within a reasonable timeframe.
sections.title: Account And Access Issues

paragraphs: You have the right to request a copy of the personal data we hold about you, to correct inaccurate data, or to request deletion of your data. To submit any of these requests, please email info@my-project.co.uk with the subject line 'Data Request' and include your registered email address and the nature of your request.
If you have concerns about how your data is being used, please review our Privacy Policy or contact us directly. We will acknowledge your request and respond within a reasonable timeframe.
sections.title: Privacy And Data Requests

paragraphs: We aim to respond to all support enquiries within two business days. Complex account or data requests may take longer. We will keep you informed of progress if additional time is needed.
Please note that support is provided in English. Out-of-hours messages will be picked up on the next available business day.
